title: self-guard configuration
description: Configuration schema for self-guard.py — AI behavior guard hook for Claude Code.

_comment.description: Human-readable description of this config file.

enabled.description: Master switch. Set to false to disable all detection without removing the hook.

mode_f.description: Mode F: Ask instead of do. Detects responses that ask 'want me to...?' instead of acting.

patterns.description: Python regex patterns (English) that match ask-instead-of-do phrasing.

patterns_zh.description: Python regex patterns (Chinese) that match ask-instead-of-do phrasing.

warning.description: Message shown to the model when Mode F is triggered.

mode_g.description: Mode G: Acknowledge without action. Detects text-only responses when user requests a change.

change_indicators.description: Patterns in the user message that signal a change/update request (English).

change_indicators_zh.description: Patterns in the user message that signal a change/update request (Chinese).

ack_patterns.description: Patterns in the assistant message that indicate a text-only acknowledgment (English).

ack_patterns_zh.description: Patterns in the assistant message that indicate a text-only acknowledgment (Chinese).

warning.description: Message shown to the model when Mode G is triggered.

mode_e.description: Mode E: Sycophancy. Detects immediate agreement after user challenge with no analysis.

surrender_threshold.description: Minimum number of surrender patterns required to trigger detection.

max_response_length.description: Responses shorter than this (in characters) with enough surrender patterns are flagged.

challenge_patterns.description: Patterns in the user message indicating a challenge (English).

challenge_patterns_zh.description: Patterns in the user message indicating a challenge (Chinese).

surrender_patterns.description: Patterns in the assistant message that signal capitulation (English).

surrender_patterns_zh.description: Patterns in the assistant message that signal capitulation (Chinese).

warning.description: Message shown to the model when Mode E is triggered.

passive_wait.description: Passive waiting: Detects deferral language without concrete justification.

action_overrides.description: If any of these patterns also appear, the deferral is considered intentional and not flagged (English).

action_overrides_zh.description: If any of these patterns also appear, the deferral is considered intentional and not flagged (Chinese).

warning.description: Message shown to the model when passive wait is triggered.
